REGULATION (EU) 2099/1 OF THE TEST PARLIAMENT

on the care of houseplants

THE TEST PARLIAMENT,

Having regard to the Treaty on Gardening,

Whereas:

(1)

Houseplants improve the well-being of their owners.

(2)

Watering should be regular but moderate.

HAVE ADOPTED THIS REGULATION:

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

Subject matter

This Regulation lays down rules on the care of houseplants.(1)

Article 2

Watering

1.   Owners shall water each plant once a week.

2.   Watering shall be reduced:

(a)

in winter;

(b)

for cacti.

CHAPTER II

LIGHT

SECTION 1

Windows

Article 3

Placement near windows

Plants listed in Annex I shall be placed near a window.

This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety.

Done at Testville, 1 January 2099.

ANNEX I

List of plants that need light

Ficus, monstera and basil.

ANNEX II

Watering calendar

Mondays in summer, every other Monday in winter.

(1)  A footnote that must not end up in any unit.
